WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 1 AS is_sale
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 0
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN is_sale=1 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_part, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_before, SUM(r.returns_net) AS ctrl_ret
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 12

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) AS nets, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS prods
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT s.store_id, MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_sale, COUNT(DISTINCT (d.receipt_id, d.line_no)) AS dup_groups, SUM(d.c) AS dup_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN d.nets>1 OR d.prods>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicting
